statements.status_notes: CVE-2024-38827 is a Spring Security advisory (spring-security-core AuthorizationManager case-sensitivity). Data Prepper ships Spring Framework 5.3.39 but does not depend on Spring Security, so the vulnerable component is not present in the image.
